array.string: import datetime,fcntl,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys root=pathlib.Path("/Users/kumiko/Projects/atlas_deepc_reacher") output=root/"experiments/three_method_faithful_v1" os.chdir(root) lock=(output/".pipeline.lock").open("a+") fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB) print("Resumed pipeline PID:",os.getpid(),flush=True) phases=("test",) if (output/"frozen.json").exists() else (("freeze","test") if (output/"tuning.json").exists() else ("tune","freeze","test")) for phase in phases: print(datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),"Starting",phase,flush=True) subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-u",str(root/"src/three_method_benchmark.py"),phase,"--output-dir",str(output)],cwd=root,check=True) print(datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),"Completed",phase,flush=True) print("Full three-method study completed; summary and plots are saved.",flush=True)
